text:
You need a backend developer who can clean and analyze restaurant data, build scalable POS integrations, and keep forecasts reliable, secure, and efficient.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience across JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. While your stack centers on PHP, I’ve worked on systems where data integrity, permissions, and automation were critical.

At Kestrel Insurance, I built an end-to-end test suite for the broker quoting flow that ran on every pull request, covering 160 tests and reducing release regressions from 6 a quarter to 1. At a healthcare staffing company, I built a staff onboarding portal where nurses uploaded credentials and managers approved them, with permissions per region, used by 2,400 staff and cutting onboarding paperwork from 5 days to 1 day.

Which part of your API or POS integration needs the most immediate improvement?
